proves.claim: clause 1: flowHomePanel(readFlow) draws the Flow markup with the unlanded item row and the idle seat from an injected reader, with no health import in apps/view.

view.io-flow.home-panel-from-injected-re.why: The home page shows the Flow panel; the view cannot import health, so the serve entry injects the reader.

proves.claim: clause 2: the page built by cockpitPage contains the Flow panel markup when a reader is injected and none when it is not.

view.io-flow.page-carries-panel-only-wit.why: Without a reader the page must not claim a flow it cannot read.
